capabilities: Render the current note or selection as WeChat Official Account HTML in a live preview
Copy the rendered HTML to the clipboard for pasting into the WeChat editor
Strip YAML frontmatter and support headings, tables, footnotes, code highlighting, and custom containers
Configure themes, fonts, code themes, and a reading-time module
Upload drafts, cover and avatar images, and local images to WeChat via its API (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a general HTML exporter; output is styled specifically for pasting into the WeChat Official Account editor.
extras: Freemium: preview and copy are free; draft upload and image upload require a paid license. Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true). Warns that AppSecret is stored in plaintext in the vault's plugin data and that WeChat API use requires IP whitelist configuration. Free users must install manually from a zip or via BRAT.
motivation: The author liked the restrained typography of the Kenengba WeChat formatter and moved that post-writing formatting workflow into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert notes into the styled HTML the WeChat Official Account editor accepts, so authors must reformat posts by hand before pasting.
